packageRules.description: Major updates wait for a tick in the Dependency Dashboard.
Roll up non-major devDependency bumps into one PR.
Svelte compiler, its Vite plugin and svelte-check move together.
Keep @hey-api/* out of the devDependencies bundle — an openapi-ts bump means regenerating the SDK and reviewing the generated diff, so give it its own PR.
